req_statements.R1: When a library payload entry carries no `enriched_at`, the panel shall derive the enrichment state `none` for that card.  - AC-1.1: The `enriched_at` guard shall run first: a record with an interpreter   but no `enriched_at` is `none`, because editing an interpreter never sets   `enriched_at` (`tests/test_download_service.py` 1014–1039). - AC-1.2: The derivation shall read no payload field other than `enriched_at`,   `artist` and `has_cover`.
req_statements.R2: When a library payload entry carries `enriched_at` and has no interpreter or no cover, the panel shall derive the enrichment state `partial`.  - AC-2.1: `enriched_at` set, `artist` null or empty, cover present → `partial`. - AC-2.2: `enriched_at` set, interpreter present, `has_cover` false → `partial`. - AC-2.3: `enriched_at` set, both missing → `partial`.
req_statements.R3: When a library payload entry carries `enriched_at`, an interpreter and a cover, the panel shall derive the enrichment state `complete`.  - AC-3.1: The cover shall be read from `has_cover`, never from `cover_url`: the   API fills `cover_url` for every record, including one with no cover file   (`src/mussol/api/app.py` 271 → `src/mussol/downloads/service.py` 279–287).
req_statements.R4: The panel shall render the enrichment marker on every library card, in the state derived for it.  - AC-4.1: The marker shall have one construction site, inside `updateRow`, and   it shall be built from the `item` that row is being updated with. - AC-4.2: `buildRow` shall build no marker.
req_statements.R5: While a card's enrichment state is `complete`, the panel shall draw its marker in the accent token.  - AC-5.1: The colour shall come from `var(--color-accent)` and from nothing   else. - AC-5.2: The marker text shall meet AA contrast on both card backgrounds the   panel renders into (`--color-card` and `--color-primary`); `design.md` § D4   carries the measured ratios.
req_statements.R6: While a card's enrichment state is `partial`, the panel shall draw its marker in the muted token with the destructive token as its border.  - AC-6.1: The text colour shall be `var(--color-muted)`; the border colour shall   be `var(--color-destructive)`. - AC-6.2: The text and the border shall each meet their WCAG contrast threshold   on both card backgrounds (`design.md` § D4).
req_statements.R7: While a card's enrichment state is `none`, the panel shall draw its marker in the muted token without a border.  - AC-7.1: The colour shall be `var(--color-muted)`, the neutral colour the   panel's own action buttons already use. - AC-7.2: The marker shall carry no border and no background.
req_statements.R8: The enrichment marker shall state its state in words, in addition to its colour.  - AC-8.1: The visible text of the marker shall be the state word: `untagged`,   `partial` or `tagged`. - AC-8.2: The marker's `title` shall name the state and, for `partial`, which   fields are missing. - AC-8.3: No state shall be carried by colour alone.
req_statements.R9: When a poll returns a payload whose `enriched_at`, `artist` or `has_cover` changed for a cached card, the panel shall show that card's marker in the new state.  - AC-9.1: `rowSignature` shall keep carrying `artist`, `has_cover` and   `enriched_at` (`web/app.js` 136, 141, 142); this feature adds no field to it. - AC-9.2: The marker shall be rebuilt by `updateRow`, which already rebuilds the   whole action row on every refresh (`web/app.js` 221, 240–257).
req_statements.R10: The panel shall not change the enrich action for a card in state `none`.  - AC-10.1: `enrichButton` shall keep its label, its request and its position in   the action row. - AC-10.2: No card action shall be disabled, dimmed or hidden because of its   enrichment state.
req_statements.R11: The feature shall not introduce a colour outside the existing palette tokens, nor any dependency loaded from the network.  - AC-11.1: No new token shall be added to `:root`, and no hex colour literal   shall appear in the rules this feature adds. - AC-11.2: `test_page_has_no_external_network_dependencies` and   `test_scripts_use_safe_sinks_only` shall stay green.
req_statements.R12: The enrichment state shall not depend on album or date.  - AC-12.1: `web/app.js` shall not name `album` or `date`. - AC-12.2: `LibraryDto`, `LibraryRecord` and the `library_records` columns shall   keep exactly the fields they have today.
